title: Add reusable image component (“image code”) with fallback handling

requirements.text: Create a reusable React/TypeScript image component that encapsulates common image behavior (loading attributes, error handling, and a visual fallback) so the app has a single, consistent “image code” pattern.
acceptanceCriteria: A new reusable image component exists (e.g., `frontend/src/components/AppImage.tsx`) that wraps an `` element.
The component supports: `src`, `alt`, `className`, optional `loading`/`decoding`, and an `onError` behavior that shows a fallback UI instead of a broken image icon.
Fallback UI is accessible (keeps meaningful alt/aria labeling) and visually reasonable with Tailwind styling.
The component does not rely on backend calls and uses only static asset paths (e.g., `/assets/generated/...`).

requirements.text: Refactor existing image usages to use the new reusable image component for consistency, specifically in `BrandLogo` and the service category cards grid.
acceptanceCriteria: `frontend/src/components/BrandLogo.tsx` uses the reusable image component and preserves its existing sizing API (`sm`/`md`/`lg`) and fallback behavior.
`frontend/src/components/CategoryGrid.tsx` uses the reusable image component and preserves existing hover/scale styling and lazy-loading behavior.
When an image fails to load, the UI does not show a broken image; it shows the defined fallback and the page layout remains stable.

constraints: Do not modify any files under `frontend/src/components/ui` (read-only UI primitives).
Do not modify files in the immutable paths list (e.g., `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts(x)`, `frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts`, `frontend/src/main.tsx`).
nonGoals: No new image generation or changes to existing generated image files.
No changes to routing or adding new pages.
